description: Operation modes for the enhancer. `operations` is a higher-level UI concept layered on top of EricRollei's prompt-context map (also ported below as `context_map` for direct use). `length_tiers` is EricRollei's word-count tier system.

expand.description: Build a full scene from a short user seed (1-5 words).

refine.description: Polish an existing user draft without changing intent or subject.

restyle.description: Keep subject and composition; change only the style, medium, and mood.

enrich.description: Add ONE specific layer (lighting / texture / atmosphere / lens) without altering the scene.

context_map.expand_short_prompt: User provided a shorthand idea. Expand it into a full, production-ready description.
context_map.finish_opening_line: Treat input as the opening line of the prompt. Continue and embellish it coherently.
context_map.prompt_from_item_list: User supplied a checklist. Transform it into a cohesive narrative scene.
context_map.modify_reference_image: Focus on altering specific parts of the reference imagery as requested.
context_map.enhance_reference_image: Use reference images as a base and enrich them with new imaginative elements.
